sloka: दह्यन्ते भृशमङ्गानि दुरात्मन् मम राघव।यन्मया ऽसि न दृष्टस्त्वं तस्मिन् काले महावने ।। ६.७९.१२ ।।
transliteration: dahyante bhṛśamaṅgāni durātman mama rāghava।yanmayā 'si na dṛṣṭastvaṁ tasmin kāle mahāvane ।। 6.79.12 ।।

translations.english: "O Evil minded Raghava! at that time, I did not see you in D and aka forest. My limbs are burning in anger."
